entries.en: Damn it!
I'm so sorry. I thought you were geth, or one of those varren.
I was trapped. I tried to get out, but the way was blocked.
I-- I was afraid. I wanted to stop the tests, but they threatened me, told me I'd be next.
Good luck with that field.
Hey... As soon as you go, I'm going to find a place to hide.
It's almost time, isn't it? Maybe we can free our friends after all. I have to help them. It's my fault this happened.
You saved most of the infected. It will take time to recover from the physical effects, but they'll be all right. Thank you.
Well, you killed it. At least that's something. But there are so many of us gone.
Who are you and what are you doing in here?
Tell me about yourself.
You stay put. I'll go open some doors.
Why do you think the geth would be interested in the Thorian?
Get her out of here!
Get away from her, you son of a bitch!
Lizbeth!
You won't get away with this.
What do you want? You've made your deals. Go ahead. It has nothing to do with us.
Thank you so much. Now ExoGeni will pour the money in. We'll be able to rebuild and then some.
Personal questions
Geth attack
I have to get moving.
Explain yourself.
It's not the geth; it's the energy field they put up.
Next thing I knew, the geth ship latched on and the power went out.
A few geth won't stop me.
I'll fight my way through the geth soon enough.
Not for me it isn't.
Not a problem.
When the geth attacked, I stayed behind to send a message to Colonial Affairs.
It's just a plant. I don't know why the geth would care.
ExoGeni was studying it, but I don't think they found anything special.
I'm just a research assistant for ExoGeni.
I came here with my mother. I don't even know if she made it out alive.
I really don't know that much about it. I think it's some kind of plant being.
I know it's very old. Thousands of years, even.
There you are!
Tell me what you know about the Thorian.
Thorian
Just get on with it. I want to at least see the Thorian dead before they ship us out of here.
This has gone on too long. Just kill the Thorian and try to help the infected.
I suppose it's time for us to go. Thank you for what you did.
It's better than dead, I suppose. I just wish.... Never mind.
Soon we'll have everything we need.
We're going to be very busy.
You won't recognize anything in a year. A clean slate.
There's nothing left here. I can't wait to get offworld.
It's hard to imagine we even had a chance.
I hope I never hear about this place ever again.
It'll be rough-going, but we have a chance.
I'm looking forward to making this place work.
It'll take a while, but we can make it.
Here, take my ID. This should get you past any locked doors.
You can't do this, Jeong!
Everyone shut up! Let me think!
What's going on?
Damn it! Come out where I can see you! All of you!
It's my own fault. Everyone else was running and I stayed to back up data.
They don't want anyone else getting access to the--
I don't know for certain, but I'm guessing they're here for the Thorian.
Thorian? What is that, exactly?
What's a Thorian?
Thorian? I have never heard of such a thing.
What's a Thorian?
Thorian? What's that?
It's an indigenous life-form. ExoGeni was studying it.
No, not exactly. But I think the geth ship is powering it.
I've noticed the geth laying power cables everywhere.
You could follow those cables, but there's geth all over the place.
Yeah, you don't have to tell me twice. I'll just find a small hole to hide in until the field is down.
She's alive? Thank God. I thought I was the only one left.
Please, Commander. Just get that field down so I can see my mother again.
We should get out of here. I don't think this place is safe.
I tried to tell them where to find the Thorian, but the power cut before I could send the message.
I-- I never meant for this to happen.
The Thorian is underneath Zhu's Hope, but the entrance is blocked.
The colonists covered it with the freighter just before the geth attacked.
Well, it does have unique mind-control capabilities.
That's what ExoGeni was interested in.
I'm coming with you. I might be able to help. Undo the mess I helped create.
You're safe now. But why were you here in the first place?
We'll get you out as soon as we find out what the geth are after.
I'm here for the geth. If you know something, tell me.
I'm here for the geth. It's very important that I find out what they're after.
Any suggestions?
Do you know how we can shut it down?
All right. I'll look into it. Stay put until the field is down.
She's with some others from the colony. She's safe for now.
I need some answers. You knew more about the Thorian than you let on.
You said you didn't know about the Thorian. I don't like being lied to.
You did what you could. I'll help them if you can tell me where to find the Thorian.
Where's the Thorian?
Just tell me where I can find the Thorian. No more lies.
But why are the geth after the Thorian? What could Saren want with it?
What bothers me is why the geth were after the Thorian in the first place.
Why are you here?
It's okay.
Don't worry.
You can tell me.
Don't hold back!
What?
Great.
How?
Fair enough.
Sounds good.
She did.
In a minute.
You lied to me.
I believe you.
Where is it?
I don't care.
I see.
Smart move.
Not a concern.
First things first.
Normandy to shore party. Come in.
Looks like they're headed your way.
What is it, Joker?
Thanks for the heads-up, Joker. You heard the man; let's move out.
You heard the man; let's move out.
Yes.
What now?
Nice job.
Okay.
Great.
I might be able to, but not with those geth crawling around everywhere.
Look, we need to get out of here, past that field.
I need more information. I need to know why the geth are after this Thorian.
What else can you tell me? Do you know where I can find this Thorian?
Tell me more.
Interesting.
Where is it?
We're getting a lot of geth comm chatter.
I read you.
